title: Kiku S8 (yae-giku / 八重菊) — editable recipe preset
note: Kiku S8 is one editable recipe preset, not the whole system. Technique (needle-action conventions) lives in techniqueRef; this file is the editable Recipe surface (marking, sizes, row order, materials, colors). Execution result (where threads actually lie) is computed by the path builder from params + occupancy — never stored here as free coordinates.

sizes.note: Reuse PARAM_SCHEMA / UI params — do not duplicate numeric stores here.

rows.note: Row count / order / packing intent are recipe; fill forecast is calculated from occupancy, not a free knob.

packingDensityIntent.note: Intent only; actual tip levels come from packThenPierce / belowPrevChannel.

colors.note: Editable color ribbon (GT14-style color plan). Per-row overrides optional; empty = inherit set color. Affects render when color mode is set (and legend); path geometry unchanged.

sameOps.rule: Step slider and stage buttons walk prefixes of the same path.ops array. Full run only advances to a later stageEnd index (skips waits); it does not rebuild a different op sequence.

recipe: chidori / upper-row growth as occupancy consequence of this preset — not hard-coded as universal core laws
